jobs.title: Material Planning Analyst - 1st Shift
jobs.description:
Logistics at full potential.

At GXO, we’re constantly looking for talented individuals at all levels who can deliver the caliber of service our company requires. You know that a positive work environment creates happy employees, which boosts productivity and dedication. On our team, you’ll have the support to excel at work and the resources to build a career you can be proud of.

1st Shift, Monday - Friday, 7:00am - 3:30pm

We’re constantly looking for ways to improve, enhance and adapt in an ever-changing marketplace. As the Material Planning Analyst you will be responsible for developing actionable analyses to improve the productivity and efficiency of our operations. If you’re ready to embrace a new challenge with a dynamic global company, we have an opportunity for you to grow with GXO.

Pay, Benefits And More.

We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability and more.

What you’ll do on a typical day:

Prepare operational analyses of services, projects or general business functions
Maintain databases; extract information and develop metrics and scorecards to measure and improve overall performance
Research operations, including performance and productivity data, error rates and root causes; review reports to identify operational issues across departments
Prepare related reports, graphs, charts, presentations and other documents to support analyses
Utilize systems and software to develop and maintain reporting tools to support business decisions
Perform supplier and location waste walks to generate cost-saving ideas for the pipeline

What you need to succeed at GXO:

At a minimum, you’ll need:

Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Business, Supply Chain or a related field, or equivalent related work or military experience
1 year of experience in comprehensive supply chain or logistics
Expertise in preparing, importing and manipulating information in spreadsheets, databases and presentations; converting raw data into usable formats
Experience with Microsoft Office (Access); ability to extract system data from SAP and utilize Excel/Access to develop reports
Experience supporting Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), order management applications and database systems
Advanced Excel skills, including the ability to perform macros

It’d be great if you also have:

Experience with SAP
Solid data mining and development skills; ability to perform statistical analysis and create queries
Ability to create solutions-based reports to improve operational efficiency and increase customer satisfaction
Fundamental comprehension of warehouse operations and the supply chain structure
Solid verbal and written communication, organizational and time management skills

We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains.

GXO is a leading provider of cutting-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer including Disabled/Veterans.

GXO adheres to CDC, OSHA and state and local requirements regarding COVID safety. All employees and visitors are expected to comply with GXO policies which are in place to safeguard our employees and customers.

All applicants who receive a conditional offer of employment may be required to take and pass a pre-employment drug test.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. All employees may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. Review GXO's candidate privacy statement here.

jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist, Entry Level
jobs.description:
Jobright is a personal AI job search agent that simplifies the job search process and helps users reach better job outcomes. The Customer Success Specialist helps customers adopt the product and realize value through onboarding, education, issue resolution, customer communication, risk escalation, and cross-functional feedback sharing.

Why Join Us

• Build real, production AI agents used by real users
• High ownership and impact
• Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
• Shape how people experience AI-driven job search

Responsibilities

• Guide new customers through onboarding and product setup
• Respond to customer questions with clear, timely, and helpful communication
• Educate customers on product features, workflows, and best practices
• Track customer goals, adoption signals, issues, and follow-up actions
• Identify risks and escalate technical or account concerns to the right teams
• Capture customer feedback and partner with product, support, and sales teams
Qualification

Required

• Strong written and verbal communication with a customer-first mindset
• Excellent organization, follow-through, and problem-solving skills
• Ability to explain product concepts clearly to different audiences
• Comfort learning software tools and managing multiple customer conversations
• Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in a remote environment

Preferred

• Internship, part-time, volunteer, or project experience in customer success, support, account management, or hospitality
• Familiarity with CRM, help-desk, project management, or collaboration tools
• Experience supporting a SaaS, technology, education, or recruiting product
• Basic ability to analyze customer usage data and identify trends

jobs.title: Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
1. About Our Client:
The organization operates in the financial advisory industry, addressing the need for personalized, objective financial advice accessible without asset minimums. It delivers comprehensive financial planning that encompasses all aspects of money management beyond investments. The team of certified professionals is supported by proprietary technology to provide holistic advice through an affordable, flat membership model. The company has earned national recognition for its innovative approach, including top rankings from USA TODAY and Newsweek, and maintains high customer satisfaction and accreditation ratings.

2. About the Opportunity:
The Compliance Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring the organization’s services and processes comply with regulatory standards while supporting innovation. This role facilitates collaboration across departments to enable compliant marketing, product development, and member services. The position contributes to maintaining the integrity of financial advice delivered and supports the company''s growth and transition to a subscription-based model.

3. Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with business units to support marketing campaigns, product development, and member services.
• Provide daily compliance guidance to enable creative and effective communication strategies.
• Manage essential compliance tasks including registrations, communication reviews, outside business activities, and regulatory filings.
• Develop policies and procedures aligned with organizational growth and subscription metrics.
• Serve as a primary contact for member issues to ensure member interests are prioritized.

4. Requirements:
• Minimum of 5 years compliance experience with a Registered Investment Advisor.
• Understanding of and willingness to support a technology-driven, flat-fee financial model.
• Ability to offer balanced, practical compliance solutions tailored to diverse stakeholders.
• Experience working with proprietary technology and AI tools.
• Strong organizational skills and capacity to provide constructive feedback.
• Adaptability to a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.

5. Pay Range and Compensation Package:
• Base salary between $100,000 and $120,000 plus bonus.
• Equity ownership in a rapidly growing financial services company.
• Remote-first work culture within the United States.
• Flexible paid time off policy.
• Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, disability insurance, paid parental leave, wellness and education reimbursement programs.

6. Benefits & Perks:
• Medical insurance
• Dental insurance
• Vision insurance
• 401(k) match
• Disability insurance
• Paid parental leave

Equal Opportunity Statement: Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

Note:
RemoteHunter is not the Employer of Record (EOR) for this role. Our purpose in this opportunity is to connect exceptional candidates with leading employers. We help job seekers worldwide discover roles that match their goals and guide them to complete their full application directly through the hiring company’s career page or ATS.

jobs.title: Compliance Analyst, Entry Level
jobs.description:
Jobright is a personal AI job search agent that simplifies the job search process and helps users reach better job outcomes. The Compliance Analyst supports policy adherence and regulatory compliance through research, control and process reviews, monitoring, audit support, remediation tracking, documentation, and stakeholder reporting.

Why Join Us

• Build real, production AI agents used by real users
• High ownership and impact
• Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
• Shape how people experience AI-driven job search

Responsibilities

• Review processes and records for alignment with policies and requirements
• Research regulatory and industry requirements and summarize their impact
• Collect evidence, maintain compliance trackers, and document review results
• Support monitoring activities, audits, and issue remediation
• Prepare clear reports, metrics, and status updates for stakeholders
• Coordinate with legal, security, operations, and product teams on compliance tasks
Qualification

Required

• Strong attention to detail, research ability, and written communication
• Ability to interpret policies and apply requirements consistently
• Comfort working with spreadsheets, documentation, and structured review workflows
• Sound judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information
• Ability to organize multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a remote environment

Preferred

• Coursework, internship, certification, or project experience in compliance, audit, legal, privacy, or security
• Exposure to privacy, consumer protection, employment, financial, or technology compliance
• Familiarity with GRC, ticketing, case management, or document management tools
• Experience supporting an audit, policy review, or control assessment
